# Checklist:
- [ ] Does similar functionality already exist in the codebase? If yes, why isn’t it reused?
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas explaining the why
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules

# Reviewer Checklist:

- [ ] Have you verified the functionality locally
- [ ] Are you aware of any potential performance or security concerns introduced by these changes?
- [ ] Does the overall implementation align with the project’s architectural patterns and requirements?
- [ ] Is the code easy to read?
- [ ] Is the code not repeated (DRY Principle)?
- [ ] Is the code method/class not too long?
- [ ] Can you think of any missing edge cases?
- [ ] Are invalid inputs validated?
- [ ] Relevant Parameters are configurable?
- [ ] Feature switched if necessary?
- [ ] Are errors and warnings logged?
